summary: Cyber Defense: a lane tower defense on a 5×9 motherboard — catch data packets, build towers, hold off ever tougher viruses for the best score of a run.
description: A 2D tower defense in the style of Plants vs Zombies (React/DOM, no engine), a mode of its own launched by the lobby's Play button. The field is a 5×9 grid, the 'motherboard'. Data packets fall over it; tapping one adds it to the player's counter. Viruses appear beyond the right edge in a random lane and walk left, each arrival tougher and sooner than the last: the Trojan, and rarely the Elite Virus with three times its health. Five towers: the Firewall (50) shoots bits along its lane while a virus is in it; the Server Rack (50) is a wall with five times its health; the Spam Filter (125) fires three times as often for half the damage; the Mech Keyboard (150) is a mine; the Cooler (175) fires icy shots that barely hurt but halve a virus's walking speed for 3 seconds. A virus that meets a tower stops and eats it; one at the left edge ends the run. Destroyed viruses give score only, and a finished run's score goes to the Title's leaderboard of the best single run. Nothing is sold or earned: a player who holds the Title's main crypto currency (an SPL token on Solana) gets rewards for holding — two tower skins and a bonus to a run's starting data packets. The game reads the wallet's balance from the chain in the browser, switches on a timed boost of the Title for every reward the holding earns and keeps renewing it; a reward works while its boost is active. A lobby tab of the module lists the rewards and what the player holds.
